title: Discussion provenance for doc_kind=discussion (a post or comment where people describe problems)
description: Added 2026-09-13 (additive). Usernames never leave the edge: author_hash is sha256(deployment salt | platform | lowercase handle), so distinct voices can be counted without storing identities.

thread_url.description: Canonical URL of the thread's opening post.

parent_url.description: Thread URL for a comment; null for the opening post itself.

engagement.description: As-of values observed once, after the item matured (see config/problem_sources.yaml).

points.description: Score or +1 votes; can be negative on Stack Exchange.
